authority: Re accepted the proposed separate descriptive qok-rate-by-image model with section adjustment. Existing H-IMG/H-PLANT tests remain unchanged; autonomous loop inactive.
scope: A new endpoint, not a replacement or retuning of v4.2 H-IMG/H-PLANT. Descriptive only; no p-values, claim-tier alpha, semantic class or sound assignments.
timing: Frozen before this analyst inspected any rater output or computed image/text joins. Ratings already began in the separate source cohort. Project-wide pre-join timing is NOT certified; source-owner hashed receipt is required before new endpoint join.
denominator: ALL word tokens judged readable by the UNCHANGED attempt-C tokenizer in eligible registered H/F P-unit lines. Numerator literal qok prefix. Partial/nonalphabetic pieces excluded and counted as unknown. Commas delimit tokens as in the original tokenizer; no new comma-adjacency exclusion. Includes line-first/final words; NOT restricted to sh/ch followers.
population: Entire independently registered, rated cohort; preserve all existing exclusions, first-page transport failure, count mismatches and timing exceptions. No new pages, reserved zodiac, rescored registrations, extra ratings, or outcome-based support filtering.
labels: Inherit geometry nearest picture category within <=2 line heights; otherwise NO. Original outcome-blind OT<5% merge rule unchanged. Registrar stays blind to picture boxes; no new rationale delivered to raters.
primary_model: Binary PL vs non-PL on lines satisfying the existing pre-adjudication G2 agreement rule. Binomial working model logit Pr(qok word)=baseline(hand x section)+beta_PL*I(PL). Report common label OR estimated by Mantel-Haenszel aggregation of qok/nonqok x PL/nonPL word counts within hand x section; report raw rates and denominators by stratum. No directional expectation imposed.
secondary_model: For the G6-qualified cohort, report each of the six fixed image labels versus the remaining labels using the same hand x section adjustment, plus raw label rates. All predefined contrasts stay descriptive; no winner selection or image-class claim. Applied OT/NO merge is reported explicitly.
wrap_sensitivity: Same PL contrast additionally stratified by inherited wrap/length bin. Diagnostic only; never substitutes for primary.
identifiability: No label variation within hand x section provides no adjusted information. Report overlap strata and missing labels; zero/zero MH ratio NOT ESTIMABLE; zero/infinite OR retained. No pseudocount, smoothing, dropped zero-qok label, or pooling hands/readings to rescue a fit.
uncertainty: 4999 paired physical-folio bootstrap refits per reading/contrast. Numeric folio groups recto/verso/panels; whole f85/f86 foldout together if eligible. Seed 4272600+1000*reading_index+100*model_index+contrast_index. Retain zero/infinite draws; any undefined 0/0 draw withholds interval. Pointwise descriptive intervals.
existing_primary_protection: H-IMG/H-PLANT eligibility, effects, OR controls, thresholds and multiplicity remain unchanged. Their qok-count abstain-only gate is not repurposed as an eligibility rule for this frequency endpoint.
before_join_requirements: Source-owner receipt certifying whether any relevant image/qok-rate join or result was examined before this freeze; no retrospective backdating.
Hash eligible cohort, shared registration, label agreement/adjudication/merge and all drops before text join.
Freeze implementation and qualify arithmetic, unknown-token handling, identifiability and cluster bootstrap on synthetic controls before manuscript scoring.
Use a source-only token parser that filters headers before bodies; do not open reserved zodiac or rater-private folders.
implementation: rate_model.py: isolated AST extraction of original tokenizer; hand x section MH label contrasts; physical-folio bootstrap reaggregates stratum counts per draw. Model fitting uses saved counts only after source-owner timing receipt.
correction_history: Before any real ratings/text join in this endpoint, code inspection showed the original tokenizer SPLITS commas rather than treating adjacent readable pieces as barriers. Initial unexecuted design retained in revisions/before-tokenizer-audit. No manuscript values examined or endpoints retuned.
